verbalization: The compound (3aR,6S,6aR)-3,6-bis(3,4,5-trimethoxyphenyl)-1,3,3a,4,6,6a-hexahydrofuro[3,4-c]furan is proposed to interact with U373 MG through a series of molecular pathways. It is identified as a target of 6'-O-Z-Para-Methoxycinnamoylharpagide, which itself is a known inhibitor of the enzyme CMP-N-acetylneuraminate-beta-1,4-galactoside alpha-2,3-sialyltransferase. This enzyme is a key player in the sialylation process, which is critical for cell surface glycoconjugate formation. The observed interaction between the compound and U373 MG suggests that the compound may modulate the activity of this enzyme, potentially affecting cellular processes that are relevant to the growth and survival of U373 MG cells. The evidence supports a mechanistic link between the compound and U373 MG, though the exact nature of the interaction remains to be fully elucidated.
